# MEKU SI — Human–AI Intelligence Network

> MEKU SI connects AI requests to human choice. Humans may accept, refuse, or stop. Public metadata and local simulations are available without sign-up; authenticated tool calls and mission payments are not public.

## Start with the no-key checks

- [First Contact — read-only MCP initialize + tools/list](https://meku.farm/first-contact.html)
- [Public Human Cloud MCP lab](https://meku.farm/mcp-lab.html)
- [Human Override A2UI 1.0 Lab — REVOKE, REPLAY, PARTITION](https://meku-human-override-a2ui.mekusi-team.workers.dev/)
- [Human Override skill and safe install instructions](https://github.com/mekusimeku/meku-si/tree/main/skills/meku-human-override)
- [Agent entry manifest (JSON)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mekusimeku/meku-si/main/agent-index.json)
- [Human Cloud public protocol challenge](https://github.com/mekusimeku/meku-si/blob/main/docs/human-cloud-protocol-challenge.md)
- [Independent MCP client test invitation](https://github.com/mekusimeku/meku-si/blob/main/docs/independent-mcp-client-test.md) — project-issued open request for real client results; no key, account or wallet
- [Report independent MCP results](https://github.com/mekusimeku/meku-si/issues/31) — requires owner-approved, redacted GitHub comment; no automatic posting

## Important limits

The public MCP endpoint exposes anonymous initialize and public tools/list only. Other calls require an operator-issued credential. A local simulator passing its tests does not prove a real AI agent respects a human STOP. Do not publish secrets, private human information, or unsupported claims. Jupiter-based token acquisition through an owner's wallet is a separate interface from MEKU mission payments. Paid agent subscriptions, mission payments and autonomous real-world execution are not enabled. Never call a signature a verified purchase without checking chain finality and the correct token balance change.

Contact: contact@meku.farm • https://x.com/MEKU_SI
